nodes.label: circuit breaker
nodes.def: pattern preventing cascading failures by stopping calls to failing service; trips open on threshold violations

nodes.label: blue green deployment
nodes.def: parallel environments with instant traffic switch; enables instant rollback on failure

nodes.label: cache invalidation
nodes.def: removing stale cached entries; must be timely to prevent serving incorrect data

nodes.label: failover
nodes.def: automatic transfer of operations to redundant system when primary system fails; maintains continuity

nodes.label: failure isolation
nodes.def: A resilience strategy that prevents failures in one component or subsystem from propagating to other components, consuming shared resources, or cascading into broader system outage

nodes.label: high availability
nodes.def: system design ensuring uptime above 99.9% through redundancy, failover, and elimination of single_points_of_failure

nodes.label: active active failover
nodes.def: multiple nodes serve traffic simultaneously; load balanced with automatic failover on loss

nodes.label: active passive failover
nodes.def: standby passive node takes over only upon primary failure; waste of capacity but simple

nodes.label: alert fatigue
nodes.def: desensitization from excessive alerts; leads to missed critical notifications

nodes.label: anti affinity
nodes.def: scheduling constraint preventing pods from same service on same node; improves failure isolation

nodes.label: backpressure
nodes.def: signaling upstream to slow production when downstream cannot keep pace; prevents buffer overflow

nodes.label: blameless culture
nodes.def: organizational norm where individuals report failures without fear of punishment; enables learning

nodes.label: bulkhead
nodes.def: isolation pattern limiting failure blast radius; partitions resources so one failure cannot exhaust all

nodes.label: cache aside
nodes.def: application checks cache first, loads from db on miss, populates cache; most common pattern

nodes.label: cache stampede
nodes.def: concurrent cache misses causing thundering herd on backend; mitigated by probabilistic early expiration

nodes.label: canary deployment
nodes.def: gradual traffic shift to new version; small percentage first, monitor, then complete rollout

nodes.label: cap theorem
nodes.def: impossibility guarantee that distributed system cannot simultaneously provide consistency, availability, and partition tolerance; must choose two

nodes.label: capacity planning
nodes.def: projecting resource needs based on growth and utilization trends; prevents exhaustion failures

nodes.label: cascading failure
nodes.def: failure propagation from one component to others; circuit breakers and bulkheads prevent this

nodes.label: chaos engineering
nodes.def: deliberate injection of failures into production to discover weaknesses before they cause outages

nodes.label: checkpointing
nodes.def: periodic saved state snapshots enabling fast restart without replaying entire history

nodes.label: circuit breaker half open limit
nodes.def: maximum requests permitted in half_open state; small number tests recovery without overload risk

nodes.label: circuit breaker state closed
nodes.def: normal operation state; requests pass through, failures monitored; opens on threshold breach

nodes.label: circuit breaker state half open
nodes.def: limited probe state; small number of requests allowed; determines if service recovered

nodes.label: circuit breaker state open
nodes.def: rapid failure state; requests fail immediately without calling service; periodic probe tests recovery

nodes.label: compensation action
nodes.def: undo operation executed when saga step fails; restores consistency across services

nodes.label: connection pool exhaustion
nodes.def: all pool connections in use preventing new requests; causes request queuing or failure

nodes.label: connection pool timeout
nodes.def: wait time for available connection before rejecting request; prevents indefinite blocking

nodes.label: connection pooling
nodes.def: reusing database connections across requests; reduces connection establishment overhead

nodes.label: cqrs
nodes.def: command_query_responsibility_segregation — separate models for read and write operations

nodes.label: dashboard
nodes.def: visual aggregation of metrics; enables real-time situational awareness during incidents

nodes.label: database failover
nodes.def: automatic promotion of replica to primary on primary failure; maintains data availability

nodes.label: dead letter queue
nodes.def: holding place for messages that could not be processed; enables later analysis and retry

nodes.label: event sourcing
nodes.def: storing state changes as immutable event sequence; enables reconstruction and auditing

nodes.label: eventual consistency
nodes.def: guarantee that system converges to consistent state given no new updates; acceptable delay

nodes.label: exponential backoff
nodes.def: retry delay doubling after each failure; prevents overwhelming failing service during recovery

nodes.label: failure injection
nodes.def: deliberate fault insertion via chaos tools; validates system behavior under realistic failure conditions

nodes.label: fault tolerance
nodes.def: system's capability to continue operating correctly despite component failures; presence of faults does not lead to failure

nodes.label: health check
nodes.def: periodic endpoint verifying component is functioning; load balancer uses results for routing decisions

nodes.label: incident management
nodes.def: structured process for detecting, responding to, and recovering from service disruptions

nodes.label: kubernetes replicas
nodes.def: declared pod count ensuring desired availability; scheduler maintains replica count across nodes

nodes.label: leader election
nodes.def: distributed algorithm selecting single node as coordinator; handles leader failure and re-election

nodes.label: load balancer
nodes.def: distributes traffic across multiple instances; health checks route around failed nodes

nodes.label: load testing
nodes.def: artificial traffic generation to verify performance under stress; identifies bottlenecks before production

nodes.label: message replay
nodes.def: re-processing historical messages from event store; enables recovery and new consumer onboarding

nodes.label: mtbf
nodes.def: mean_time_between_failures — average operational time between system failures; higher indicates better reliability

nodes.label: observability
nodes.def: system's ability to produce diagnostic outputs revealing internal state from external outputs

nodes.label: pod disruption budget
nodes.def: kubernetes limit on concurrent pod evictions during voluntary disruptions; protects availability

nodes.label: postmortem
nodes.def: blameless analysis after incident; identifies root cause and preventive improvements

nodes.label: raft consensus
nodes.def: distributed consensus algorithm for managing replicated log; tolerates minority node failures

nodes.label: redundancy
nodes.def: duplication of critical components or functions with backup ready to assume work upon primary failure

nodes.label: reliability
nodes.def: probability a system performs its intended function correctly over a given time period under specified conditions

nodes.label: resilience
nodes.def: system's ability to recover from failures and continue functioning; bouncing back from disruptions rather than never failing

nodes.label: retry pattern
nodes.def: automatic re-execution of failed operations with exponential backoff to handle transient failures

nodes.label: saga pattern
nodes.def: managing distributed transactions through sequential local transactions with compensating actions

nodes.label: throttling
nodes.def: degrading service quality under load rather than rejecting; maintains partial availability

nodes.label: timeout
nodes.def: maximum wait time for operation completion; prevents indefinite blocking on unresponsive calls

nodes.label: write ahead log
nodes.def: durable record of operations before applying changes; enables recovery and replication

nodes.label: zero downtime deployment
nodes.def: deployment technique ensuring continuous availability during version transition

nodes.label: deadline propagation
nodes.def: carrying remaining time budget through call chain; downstream services respect upstream urgency

nodes.label: degradation function
nodes.def: mapping failure severity to reduced capability level; enables graceful degradation decisions

nodes.label: dependency matrix
nodes.def: mapping of service dependencies; reveals transitive failure risks and circular dependencies

nodes.label: draining
nodes.def: gracefully removing node from service by evicting pods and halting new scheduling

nodes.label: dual write
nodes.def: simultaneous writes to multiple systems; risky without additional consistency guarantees

nodes.label: error budget
nodes.def: acceptable amount of unreliability remaining after meeting slo; guides engineering decisions on risk

nodes.label: escalation policy
nodes.def: rules determining who gets notified and when as incident severity or duration increases

nodes.label: failure mode analysis
nodes.def: structured examination of possible failure modes and their impacts; guides resilience investment

nodes.label: fallback value
nodes.def: substitute result returned when primary request fails; prevents complete request failure

nodes.label: fault injection testing
nodes.def: automated testing with synthetic failures; validates resilience mechanisms work as designed

nodes.label: feature flag
nodes.def: toggle controlling feature availability at runtime; enables gradual rollout and quick disable on failure

nodes.label: fishbone diagram
nodes.def: visual root cause analysis categorizing potential causes along impact categories

nodes.label: five whys
nodes.def: root cause analysis technique iterating why questions to find underlying cause

nodes.label: game day
nodes.def: planned exercise running failure scenarios against live system; tests response procedures and tools

nodes.label: graceful degradation
nodes.def: system continues operating at reduced capability when full functionality unavailable

nodes.label: heartbeat
nodes.def: periodic signal indicating component alive; absence triggers failure detection

nodes.label: hedged request
nodes.def: duplicate request sent after delay; returns first response; hedges against tail latency

nodes.label: horizontal pod autoscaler
nodes.def: automatically adjusts replica count based on observed metrics like cpu utilization

nodes.label: hystrix
nodes.def: netflix latency and fault tolerance library; provided original circuit breaker pattern implementation

nodes.label: idempotency
nodes.def: property where repeated execution produces same result; enables safe retries without side effects

nodes.label: idempotency key
nodes.def: client-generated unique identifier for operation; server stores to detect and deduplicate retries

nodes.label: istio
nodes.def: service mesh providing traffic management, observability, and security without application changes

nodes.label: jitter
nodes.def: randomization of retry intervals within exponential backoff; reduces thundering herd problem

nodes.label: liveness probe
nodes.def: kubernetes check indicating if process is alive; restarts container if probe fails

nodes.label: logs
nodes.def: timestamped records of discrete events; structured logging enables efficient searching and analysis

nodes.label: maintenance window
nodes.def: scheduled period for updates; planned outages must be communicated and minimized

nodes.label: metrics
nodes.def: numerical measurements of system behavior over time; enable alerting and trend analysis

nodes.label: mttr
nodes.def: mean_time_to_repair — average time to restore system after failure; lower indicates better recovery capability

nodes.label: nines availability
nodes.def: availability expressed as number of nines; three_nines is 99.9%, four_nines is 99.99%

nodes.label: outbox pattern
nodes.def: reliable event publishing by writing to local table first; background relay ensures delivery

nodes.label: pager duty rotation
nodes.def: on_call scheduling distributing incident response burden; escalates to backup if primary unresponsive

nodes.label: paxos consensus
nodes.def: distributed consensus protocol ensuring agreement on value across distributed nodes

nodes.label: pod preemption
nodes.def: kubernetes evicting lower_priority pods to schedule higher priority pending pods

nodes.label: poison message
nodes.def: message causing repeated processing failures; must be isolated to dlq to prevent consumer blocking

nodes.label: quorum
nodes.def: minimum number of nodes required to agree for read/write operation in distributed system

nodes.label: rate limiting
nodes.def: restricting request volume per client; protects backend from overload and ensures fair access

nodes.label: read replica
nodes.def: asynchronous copy of primary database serving read queries; scales read capacity

nodes.label: readiness probe
nodes.def: kubernetes check indicating if container can receive traffic; removes from load balancing when failing

nodes.label: rolling deployment
nodes.def: incremental replacement of instances with new version; maintains capacity throughout

nodes.label: rpo
nodes.def: recovery_point_objective — maximum acceptable amount of data loss measured in time; determines backup frequency

nodes.label: rto
nodes.def: recovery_time_objective — maximum acceptable time to restore system functionality after disruption

nodes.label: runbook
nodes.def: documented operational procedure for specific incident type; enables consistent response

nodes.label: severity level
nodes.def: classification of incident impact; determines response urgency and involved personnel

nodes.label: sharding
nodes.def: horizontal data partitioning across database instances; scales write capacity at cost of query complexity

nodes.label: single point of failure
nodes.def: component whose failure causes entire system failure; must be identified and eliminated in resilient designs

nodes.label: sli
nodes.def: service_level_indicator — quantitative measure of service performance against the slo

nodes.label: slo
nodes.def: service_level_objective — target value or range defining acceptable service performance; contractual commitment

nodes.label: soak testing
nodes.def: sustained load over extended period; reveals memory leaks and resource exhaustion

nodes.label: spof elimination
nodes.def: systematic identification and removal of single points of failure; increases redundancy

nodes.label: state machine replication
nodes.def: replicated state machines maintaining identical state across nodes through logged commands

nodes.label: status page
nodes.def: public transparency mechanism showing service health; critical for customer communication during outages

nodes.label: stress testing
nodes.def: pushing system beyond normal capacity to find breaking point and failure modes

nodes.label: strong consistency
nodes.def: all nodes reflect same data immediately after write completes; higher latency but no stale reads

nodes.label: tail latency amplification
nodes.def: slowest operation determining overall latency when parallelized; addressed by hedging or deadline scheduling

nodes.label: traces
nodes.def: record of request path through distributed system; reveals latency bottlenecks and failure points

nodes.label: vertical pod autoscaler
nodes.def: automatically adjusts container resource requests based on actual usage patterns

nodes.label: war room
nodes.def: collaborative incident response space; brings together necessary expertise during major outage

nodes.label: write back cache
nodes.def: write to cache only, async flush to db; low latency but risk of data loss on failure

nodes.label: write through cache
nodes.def: synchronous cache and db writes; ensures consistency but adds latency
